summary: Design agent completed Low-Level Design for FR-BRICK-003 (Issue #11) — Provide brick palette with 6 brick types and 12 colors. LLD covers: component architecture (BrickPalette.tsx, BrickTypeCard.tsx, ColorSwatchGrid.tsx, ErrorBoundary.tsx), TypeScript interfaces (BrickTypeId, ColorId, BrickGeometry, BrickTypeDefinition, ColorDefinition), full brick catalog (6 types: 1x1, 1x2, 1x4, 2x2, 2x3, 2x4 with Three.js BoxGeometry dimensions), full color palette (12 named colors with hex, Tailwind class, contrast hex), uiStore Zustand slice (activeBrickType, activeColor, isPaletteOpen), 4 Mermaid sequence diagrams (brick type selection, color selection, brick placement, palette toggle), SVG icon rendering strategy, 4x3 color swatch grid, error handling matrix (6 scenarios), security considerations, accessibility (aria-pressed, aria-label, prefers-reduced-motion), performance budget, test case mapping (T-BE-BRICK-003-01, T-BE-BRICK-003-02, T-FE-UI-002-01, T-FE-UI-002-03, T-E2E-BRICK-001-01), file checklist (13 files), 5 open questions, and 5 alternatives considered. Draft PR is open on branch feature/11-fr-brick-003-design awaiting Gate 6a human design review before merge to main. Area determined as frontend (pure client-side SPA, React/Three.js/Zustand/Vitest toolchain).

human_review_required.item: Gate 6a Design Review — Draft PR on branch feature/11-fr-brick-003-design must be reviewed and approved by a human before implementation begins.

OQ-5: SVG icon designs — Confirm SVG top-down footprint icons are acceptable, or if 3D thumbnails are required.
OQ-3: Mobile palette collapse — Confirm whether isPaletteOpen should default to false on mobile (< 768 px).
